LESSON: SARUFI 7.4.1 NGELI YA KU-KU

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi
2. kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU
3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU.
4. Show that you can: kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 7.4.1 Ngeli ya KU-KU important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua viambishi vipatanishi vya ngeli ya KU-KU kwenye sentensi
2. kutambua nomino katika ngeli ya KU- KU
3. kutumia nomino za ngeli ya KU-KU katika umoja na wingi akizingatia upatanisho wa kisarufi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
